subject: Gender Affirming and Reproductive Healthcare Ordinance
overview: The committee met to discuss a draft ordinance securing rights to gender-affirming and reproductive healthcare in Medford. The committee voted to keep the matter in committee pending a forthcoming legal review from city solicitors.

items.title: Ordinance for Gender-Affirming and Reproductive Healthcare Protections
items.summary: The committee discussed a draft ordinance to protect providers and recipients of gender-affirming and reproductive healthcare in Medford, voting to keep the matter in committee pending a full legal review.
